correctness.rationale: Independent finite-field certificate reconstructed the six-dimensional space of ternary cubics through four F3 frame points: exactly 364 projective sections; direct derivative-zero checks in all projective points of F3,F9,F27 give 201,132,132 smooth survivors, agreeing with geometrically smooth 132 via the degree≤3 singular-point reduction for plane cubics. Enumerated all 11011 projective two-spaces and found exactly 240 with four smooth F3 sections; checked all nine candidates outside each and no smooth projective net. Independently generated 24 rational projective frame automorphisms and Cremona involution, yielding full 120-element S5 action and exactly two free orbits 120+120; point spectra (6,6,6,7) and (5,6,7,7). Independent polynomial resultant of F with each G_A/G_B factors Y(Y−1)H_A/B where H are irreducible degree-five over F3. Together with transversality at 4 blown-up base points, Bézout gives one geometrically reduced degree-five residual base point for each orbit. This is exhaustive for the F3 setup, not a claim about all geometrically parametrized members.
